# Average Directional Index

*Trend strength (Wilder), 0 to 100.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Average Directional Index** under **Trend**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ADX smoothing | int | `14` |
| DI length | int | `14` |
| Color | color | `"#FF5252"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/adx.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Average Directional Index", shortTitle: "ADX", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const smoothing = input.int("ADX smoothing", 14, { min: 1 }), diLength = input.int("DI length", 14, { min: 1 });
plot(ta.adx(diLength, smoothing), { title: "ADX", color: input.color("Color", "#FF5252", { group: "Style" }) });
```
